key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1195 annex listing harmonised standards for in vitro diagnostic devices.
Publishes EN ISO 14971:2019 and its A11:2021 amendment (risk management) as harmonised standard references.
Adds corrigendum EN ISO 13485:2016/AC:2018 to the quality management standard entry, with retroactive effect from 7 January 2022.
Compliance gives presumption of conformity with Regulation (EU) 2017/746.
Enters into force on day of publication.
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/729 amends the list of harmonised standards for in vitro diagnostic medical devices, adding EN ISO 14971 (risk management) and the ISO 13485 corrigendum, conferring presumption of conformity under Regulation (EU) 2017/746. It has no AI or robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/729 of 11 May 2022 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1195 as regards harmonised standards for quality management systems and for application of risk management to medical devices
